description: A memory leak leaves an allocation without the cleanup it needs. You can trace responsibility from make_data to its caller.

steps.description: make_data allocates a vector on the heap. The vector starts with n zero-valued elements.
The loop stores squares in the vector. Returning v passes its pointer to the caller.
leak_demo receives that pointer and reads one element.
The caller leaves out delete data. The allocated vector and its storage remain unreleased.

title: Lose track of an allocation
